summary: Phac thao tren khung hinh: chen chu, khung, anh, o giu cho, khung crop va vung che mo ngay tren video khi review.
changes: Cong cu ve trong trang review thanh trinh phac thao: chu (phu de, tieu de, lower third) voi co chu / dam / bong / nen, khung chu nhat va elip co nen, mui ten, duong thang, but va but da quang.
Chen anh (logo, anh tham khao) bang nut, dan Ctrl/Cmd V hoac keo tha vao khung hinh; anh duoc thu nho truoc khi tai len NAS.
O giu cho B-roll / logo / PiP, khung crop 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 lam toi phan bi cat, vung che mo; menu Mau nhanh chen san cac bo cuc hay dung.
Chon, keo, doi kich thuoc, nhan ban, doi lop, hoan tac / lam lai va phim tat nhu trinh editor; bam dup de sua chu.
Ghi chu hien anh thu nho cua phac thao; nguoi viet hoac quan ly co the sua lai phac thao sau khi gui. Hinh ve cu van hien dung.
